role: Power Systems Engineer · KTH InnoEnergy SENSE MSc
bioFront: Power systems engineer with hands-on experience in PSS®E, PowerFactory, and Python automation from GE Vernova and Siemens. Now on the EIT InnoEnergy SENSE MSc at KTH Stockholm, focused on offshore wind, HVDC, and grid digitalization.
backParagraphs: I’m a power systems engineer working at the intersection of **grid digitalization, renewable energy integration, and Python-based automation**.

At Siemens I automated PSS®E and TSAT workflows in Python, cutting contingency analysis runtime by 70% and simulation runtime by 94% through parallel processing. At GE Vernova I performed short-circuit, load flow, and transient stability studies in PSS®E and PowerFactory for utility and industrial clients across the US.

I am now on the **SENSE MSc at KTH Royal Institute of Technology** (Year 1), followed by KU Leuven in Belgium (Year 2), as part of the EIT InnoEnergy dual degree programme. Focus: offshore wind grid integration, HVDC, and smart grid control.
Longer term I’m drawn to the intersection of power engineering and capital allocation · the technical due diligence and infrastructure investment building the energy transition.
